title: SuperTuxKart 1.5 uncapped Vulkan Mailbox: the v0.26.0 candidate showing the engine's surface in a child window, the v0.25.0 shared memory path, BlueStacks 5, Kemu and LDPlayer 14, alternated in one session
generated_from: session record duel2-final2.json and its console, the RustEmuDroid step results, and the BlueStacks, Kemu and LDPlayer operator receipts; a second same-day session duel2-final1 (01:30-02:53) is under same_day_series_final1

host.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti, connected as an external GPU over Thunderbolt 3

workload.vk_present_mode: VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR (1), logged in every lap of every player
workload.measurement_source: frame count and profiled duration of the game's own frame report

power_mode.name: Best performance
power_mode.note: In final2 the overlay before the session was Balanced (00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000): every step recorded Balanced before it, Best performance while it ran and Balanced put back after it. In final1 Best performance was already on and stayed on. Balanced was not measured.

background.owners_ldplayer_instance: The owner's own LDPlayer 14 instance (index 0) stayed open for both sessions; its VM process Ld9BoxHeadless.exe used about 0.05-0.14 core in the samples.
background.owners_everyday_android_vm: The BlueStacks and Kemu operators expect the owner's everyday RustEmuDroid VM running, close it for their timed boot and reopen it afterwards; the session opened it (then rested 120 s) before each BlueStacks/Kemu pair and closed it before the RustEmuDroid and LDPlayer steps.
